rules.title: NJ FAIR Act (Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent Act)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rents. Software providers and other coordinators may not use such software to facilitate agreements or coordinate pricing among competing landlords.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic revenue management software using nonpublic competitor data
citation_aliases: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent Act
rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices.
rules.effective_date_note: Document states the act takes effect July 1, 2027; signed July 20 (2026).
rules.exemptions: Does not prohibit spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, and government-administered affordable housing programs.
rules.penalty: Attorney general complaint portal; existing remedies under the New Jersey Antitrust Act preserved.
rules.interaction: May preempt Jersey City and Hoboken local algorithmic rent-setting ordinances once effective.
rules.conflict_note: Possible preemption of Jersey City and Hoboken ordinances once effective; document does not address this.

parsed.doc_summary: Day Pitney news alert on NJ's FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c. 43), signed July 20, 2026, banning algorithmic rent-setting using nonpublic competitor data, effective July 1, 2027.
